amendments.proposed: 2aa.	By way of derogation from the obligation to surrender allowances pursuant to Article 12(3), point (a), installations producing ceramic products by firing, in particular roofing tiles, bricks, refractory bricks, tiles, stoneware or porcelain, covered by Annex I, shall be exempt from the obligation to surrender allowances for the period from 2026 to 2030. For the year 2027, they shall be allocated additional free allowances corresponding to the number of allowances surrendered in respect of their verified emissions for the year 2026. The additional allowances allocated pursuant to this paragraph shall be deducted from the quantity of allowances that would otherwise be auctioned pursuant to Article 10(1).

amendments.proposed: 2ba.	For the purposes of the adjustments to the heat and fuel benchmark values provided for in this paragraph, a total of 22 million allowances shall be transferred from the market stability reserve established by Decision (EU) 2015/1814 and made available for free allocation for the period from 2026 to 2030. That quantity shall be additional to, and shall not replace or be deducted from, any other quantities of allowances made available for those adjustments and shall be used in full for that purpose
